title: Professional copy refresh and Gothic Falcon IDs wordmark branding update

requirements.summary: Remove role-play/cosplay/props/novelty language from all user-facing copy and replace with concise, professional legality/validity notices.
acceptanceCriteria: No user-facing text contains the words/phrases: "role-play", "roleplay", "cosplay", "props", or "novelty use" (case-insensitive).

Update the following known locations so they comply: frontend/src/content/copy.ts (e.g., LANDING_DISCLAIMER, ORDER_FORM_DISCLAIMER), frontend/src/components/NoveltyDisclaimerBanner.tsx, frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx (hero subtitle + disclaimer block), frontend/src/pages/NewOrderPage.tsx (disclaimer block), frontend/src/components/IdCardPreview.tsx (card footer line).
Any remaining disclaimer/notice text is written in clear, professional English and does not imply roleplay/cosplay/props/novelty usage.

file_operations.description: Rewrite user-facing disclaimers and related marketing copy to remove any role-play/cosplay/props/novelty language, while keeping a concise, professional validity/legal-use notice (update at minimum: LANDING_HERO_SUBTITLE, LANDING_DISCLAIMER, ORDER_FORM_DISCLAIMER, DISCLAIMER_BANNER).

Update the banner message so it remains concise and professional, and does not reference role-play/cosplay/props/novelty; prefer sourcing the banner string from frontend/src/content/copy.ts (e.g., COPY.DISCLAIMER_BANNER) to keep disclaimer copy consistent site-wide.

Remove/replace any hero subtitle and disclaimer-block phrasing that implies role-play/cosplay/props/novelty usage; ensure the landing page hero subtitle reads realistic/professional and the disclaimer block uses the updated COPY text.
Ensure the order-page disclaimer block renders updated professional notice text (via COPY.ORDER_FORM_DISCLAIMER) and does not contain any role-play/cosplay/props/novelty language.
Replace the ID card footer disclaimer line so it is professional and validity-focused (no role-play/cosplay/props/novelty references), while remaining concise.

requirements.summary: Replace all visible logo placements with the new Gothic “Falcon IDs” wordmark asset.
acceptanceCriteria: All pages that currently render the logo image (e.g., frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx and frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) are updated to use the new Gothic “Falcon IDs” wordmark asset(s).
No old logo asset filenames remain referenced in the frontend codebase (e.g., /assets/generated/falcon-ids-logo-transparent.dim_1200x300.png is no longer used).
The displayed brand text reads exactly “Falcon IDs” (spacing/case) in all branded placements.

file_operations.description: Add the generated Gothic-style wordmark asset (transparent background) at this exact path and filename for use in header/hero branding.

Update the header branding to use the new wordmark asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/falcon-ids-wordmark-gothic-transparent.dim_1200x300.png, ensure alt text/brand label renders as exactly “Falcon IDs”, and remove any references to prior logo filenames.

Update the landing hero logo to use the new wordmark asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/falcon-ids-wordmark-gothic-transparent.dim_1200x300.png, ensure displayed brand text reads exactly “Falcon IDs”, and remove any references to prior logo filenames.
Remove the old transparent logo asset to prevent accidental reuse and help ensure it is no longer referenced anywhere.
Remove the old non-transparent logo asset to prevent accidental reuse and help ensure it is no longer referenced anywhere.
Remove the old alternate logo asset to prevent accidental reuse and help ensure it is no longer referenced anywhere.

requirements.summary: Update favicon and apple-touch icon references to new Gothic “Falcon IDs” branded assets.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html <link rel="icon"> points to the new favicon asset.
frontend/index.html <link rel="apple-touch-icon"> points to the new apple-touch icon asset.
The browser tab icon and iOS home-screen icon reflect the updated Gothic “Falcon IDs” branding.

file_operations.description: Add the generated Gothic-style favicon asset at this exact path and filename so frontend/index.html can reference it.
Add the generated Gothic-style apple touch icon asset at this exact path and filename so frontend/index.html can reference it.

Update <link rel="icon"> to reference frontend/public/assets/generated/falcon-ids-favicon-gothic.dim_32x32.png and update <link rel="apple-touch-icon"> to reference frontend/public/assets/generated/falcon-ids-apple-touch-gothic.dim_180x180.png; ensure the document title remains “Falcon IDs”.
Remove the old favicon asset to prevent accidental reuse after frontend/index.html is updated.
Remove the old apple-touch icon asset to prevent accidental reuse after frontend/index.html is updated.
